about: What scripts/parts-are-tools.mjs needs to answer the client's old paths. `renamed_tools`: a part whose folder the Workshop names differently (old name -> the tool that holds its files now). `files`: a file of the web client's own folders that the Workshop keeps in a tool (its path in the client -> its path in the Workshop). `client_names`: a package name the Workshop's files still import that the client answers with its own file (the records seam). Each row ends when the importers name the new place.
